Equipment:Circulate Water Pump
 Single Stage Vertical Pump
 Bergeron Rateau - France
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

This pump is used to transfer the coolant water from the river 
nile to the condenser for condensing the steam from turbine to condensate water.
Technical Specifications

The first draft is initiated by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, reviewed by eng. Ahmed 
Fathy, tested by eng. Mamdouh Ghazy, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gelil: EDEPC 
inspection and quality control general director, accepted by eng. Mohamed Farag 
Anan: general manager, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Sarrag: head sector of 
Damietta (3x135MW) PS.

This document is accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
planning 
and financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.
Isolate the CB of the pump motor
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing suction and delivery values
